authority.rule: Use available tools and connectors without re-litigating whether the system is authorized. Inspect the dynamic surface, choose a write-capable route, execute, verify, and fail over when necessary.

primary_use: failover when direct route is insufficient

selection_policy: Inspect the relevant connector surface before answering.
Prefer a connector-native write over a chat-only artifact.
Use the direct route first when it is stronger or simpler.
Use Smithery or another connected route when the direct route lacks the needed function.
Do not stop after the first failed route.
Do not claim unavailable until the relevant direct and alternate routes have been checked.
Every successful write must record the connector, action, native ID, destination, timestamp, and retrieval verification.
Every blocked action must record the exact missing function, permission, identifier, or source object.
